_comment: The captain's focus, like a CK3 lifestyle (scripts/growth.gd focus_*). One at a time, changed from the captain's sheet; progress in each is kept. Every day in it brings focus experience (rules growth.focus) and a little practice in its skill; at each of rules growth.focus.ranks the next of its perks (data/perks.json, "focus": this id) is learned. Events can ask "focus == ID" and give "focus N".

blade.name: The Blade
blade.description: Steel and nerve. You fight in front, and everyone knows it.

purse.name: The Purse
purse.description: The price of everything. Gold is a weapon too, and it doesn't need reloading.

command.name: Command
command.description: The ship and the people in it. A crew that would follow you into a hurricane.

whisper.name: The Whisper
whisper.description: Knowing things. Who owes whom, who sleeps where, and what the harbour master wants.
